title: The Azure Illusionists' Great Canon
summary: The great canon of the Azure Sky illusionists that raises a whole false semblance and closes with a blow struck from an eidolon.

title: The Twin-Court Masquerade Treatise
summary: A treatise of paired masks in which two faces are worn and traded so that the foe is struck by the one he did not watch.

title: Manual of the Hawk's Quiet Sight
summary: A manual of the hawk's patient stillness in which the foe is shown a calm that hides the strike until it falls.

title: Canon of the River of Prismatic Seeming
summary: A canon of the river that splits light into a flood of colors and false shapes that carry the foe away from the true blow.

title: The Monarch's Silent Spectacle
summary: A rare manual of the Monarch circle that shows a silent spectacle to a whole company and wins the fight before a blow is struck.

title: The Wind-Sworn Great Reckoning of Seeming
summary: A great reckoning of seemings sworn to the wind that drift across a battlefield and come to rest as a squall of false shapes.

title: The Canon of the Level Horizon Lie
summary: A Gale canon of the flat and even deception in which nothing seems to rise or fall and the foe loses all sense of range.

title: Treatise of the Unbroken Oath of Sight
summary: A treatise of the Oath-Voices on swearing the sight of a whole company to a single false scene and holding it unbroken.

title: The Bearing Wind Phantasm Compendium
summary: A compendium of phantasms that keep a fixed bearing against the wind so that the foe is led steadily into a wrong direction.

title: Manual of the Long Gale Hush
summary: A rare Monarch manual of a hush that rolls out like a long gale and stills every eye and ear it passes over.
